propositions: Hand-rolled CLI argument parsing loops in claim.py and transition.py must be refactored to use stdlib argparse without changing observable behavior or help output.

The argparse refactor must preserve command-specific --force semantics: claim bare --force consumes next non-option token else uses '(no reason given)'; transition bare --force sets force_reason='' (None only when absent) and does not consume following tokens.
The --assignee None-vs-empty-string distinction must be preserved where absent triggers default_assignee fallback and explicit empty string clears the assignee.
transition._parse_flags must remain a retained shim returning the identical 5-tuple (reason, force_reason, close_class, caused_by, ref) for three external direct callers to pass unchanged.

Unknown/extra tokens must be silently skipped via parse_known_args; --help must remain dispatcher-served byte-exact from golden help files; retired --force-close must exit 1 with its historical message.
The refactored parser must use add_help=False, allow_abbrev=False, and a custom error() method raising CommandError(returncode=1) to preserve exit codes and error message formats.
